title: 2. Confident
slide_intent: Define the limits of confidence so writers can express personality without creating the wrong impression.
strategic_value: Grounded claims about heritage and food can give Burger King confidence without alienating customers.
demonstration: Bold, proud and challenging language is bounded by cautions against flashy, vain and confrontational expression. The right column compares familiar brand claims and invitations with regal boasting and confrontation.
practical_value: Check that pride rests on a recognizable product truth rather than a boast or threat.
